# Priority Dispatch LLC

> Priority Dispatch LLC is a USA truck dispatching company based in Kissimmee, Florida. It dispatches owner-operators and small trucking fleets in all 48 continental states, with a focus on the Midwest, the East Coast and California: finding and booking loads, negotiating rates, vetting brokers, handling paperwork and invoicing, with 24/7 support. Fees run from 4% of the gross load, paid only after the broker pays, with no setup fee and no contract.

## Key facts

- Business: truck dispatching service (works for carriers, not a freight broker)
- Location: 804 Brack St, Kissimmee, FL 34744, USA (near Orlando)
- Coverage: all 48 continental US states; focus regions are the Midwest, the East Coast and California
- Phone: +1 (689) 314-8347
- Email: prioritydispatch4u@gmail.com
- Hours: 24/7 dispatch support
- Founder and CEO: Muhammad Faisal Bilal
- Equipment dispatched: dry van, reefer, flatbed, step deck, power only, box truck, hotshot, sprinter van

## Dispatch fees (percentage of the gross load)

- Dry van: 4%
- Reefer: 4%
- Flatbed: 4%
- Step deck: 4%
- Power only: 4%
- Box truck: 6%
- Hotshot: 6%
- Sprinter / cargo van: 10%
- Fleets of 2 or more trucks: negotiable
- Terms: paid only after the broker pays the carrier; no setup fee; no contract; no minimum loads; the carrier can refuse any load; detention and TONU claims included

## Common questions

- How much does a truck dispatcher charge? Most US dispatchers charge 3% to 10% of the gross load or a flat weekly fee. Priority Dispatch charges 4% for dry van, reefer, flatbed, step deck and power only, 6% for box trucks and hotshots, and 10% for sprinter vans.
- Is a truck dispatcher a freight broker? No. A broker works for the shipper under its own broker authority; a dispatcher works for the carrier under the carrier's MC authority.
- Do I need a local dispatcher? Dispatching is done by phone, email and load boards, so location matters less than lane knowledge. Priority Dispatch is based in Florida and dispatches in all 48 states.
- How fast can I start? Usually within 24 to 48 hours of sending MC authority, W-9 and certificate of insurance through the carrier setup page.
